name: sidebar-animated

frames.best_why: Frame 1 shows the expanded sidebar with its full menu, the active highlight and the dashboard content.

tagline: App sidebar with one highlight that glides between items and collapses to icons.
summary: A shadcn-style application sidebar with grouped navigation, a project list and a user footer. A single rounded highlight slides from item to item, and the panel can collapse to a narrow icon rail.
appearance: A tall dark panel on the left lists grouped navigation in small white and grey text with tiny icons, a project section, and a user row at the bottom. It sits beside a dark dashboard with a slim top bar, three stat cards and a large empty panel.
behaviour: Moving between menu items slides one rounded grey highlight from the old row to the new one. Toggling the sidebar collapses it smoothly to a narrow icon-only rail and expands it back; the main content widens as it goes.
demo_content: Workspace 'Acme Inc' with Playground, History, Starred, Models, Documentation, Projects and a Maya Chen user row.
search_phrases: dashboard navigation that collapses to icons
use_when: A dashboard or app shell needs persistent navigation that can collapse to icons to give content more room.
avoid_when: It is built for a desktop app shell with grouped menus and a set width, so a marketing site or phone layout fits poorly.
customise: Open state, default open and hover animation are provider props; the menu groups, projects and user row are composed by you as children, and widths are CSS variables.
weight_why: Tracks every menu item with a mutation observer and animates one highlight plus the collapse.

a11y.note: Reduced motion is respected and the collapse has a keyboard shortcut, but collapsed items rely on composed tooltips to keep their names.

issues: The workspace name at the top of the sidebar is clipped by the crop.
polish_why: A convincing app shell with a smooth highlight and collapse; tiny type keeps it ordinary.
